English language requirements for postgraduate applicants
You may need to provide a recognised English language qualification depending on your nationality and where you have studied previously.
The English language scores required vary depending on the course that you are applying for. You can find these in the entry requirements for each course on the course information pages.
How to meet our English Language requirements
The information provided below is relevant to 2027 entry and may change for future entry years.
You can provide evidence of your English language ability in several ways. Details are listed below.
Hide all sections
Recognised English language qualifications
We accept the following tests as evidence of English language ability:
IELTS Academic (UKVI Approved), IELTS Academic (Other Centres), IELTS Online, IELTS One Skill Retake (OSR)
TOEFL IBT (including My Best Scores), TOEFL IBT Home Edition
Pearson PTE Academic (test taken in person at a test centre only), Pearson PTE UKVI (test taken in person at a test centre only)
LanguageCert Academic (including Online and SELT)
Kaplan Test of English
Oxford ELLT, Oxford ELLT Skill Retake
Oxford Test of English Advanced
Cambridge English: Advanced CAE
Cambridge English: Proficiency (CPE)
CaMLA ECPE
TRINITY ISE
IELTS, TOEFL, Pearson, LanguageCert, Kaplan and Oxford Test of English Advanced certificates are valid for 2 years from the test date and your certificate will need to be valid on the start date of your studies at Lancaster. If you have taken a test multiple times, we cannot combine scores together to meet the requirements.
You can register online for the Oxford ELLT digital test. Use this link and our discount code LU10 to receive a 10% discount on the cost of the test.
If you take the Pearson test, you will need to give permission for Lancaster University to verify your score.
If your English language score does not meet our requirements, we may be able to consider you for one of our pre-sessional English language programmes.
High school English
If you have not taken one of our recognised English language qualifications we may be able to accept an alternative English language qualification. The alternatives we may be able to consider are detailed below by country.
Botswana: Cambridge Overseas School Certificate (English) Grades 1-6 inclusive / Botswana General Certificate of Secondary Education (BGCSE) in English at Grade C or above
Brunei: Cambridge GCE O Level (English) Grade 6 or above
Cameroon: Cameroon GCE O Level (English) Grade C or above
Ghana: GCE O Level (English) Grade C or above / Senior Secondary Certificate Examination (SSCE) in English, Grade C6 or above
India: Indian Standard XII English at 80% or above or 75% or above from the CBSE and ISC examination boards. (We do not accept Standard XII English from Punjab or Haryana State Boards. Applicants with qualifications from these boards will need to complete IELTS or another accepted English test.)
Kenya: Kenyan Certificate of Secondary Education (KCSE) in English at Grade C or above
Malaysia: Malaysian 1119 syllabus (UCLES) English at Grade C or above / GCE O Level (English) Grade C or above
Mauritius: GCE O Level / GCSE English, Grade C or above
Nigeria: WAEC/WASSCE/NECO in English at Grade C6 or above
Philippines: High School Diploma in English at Grade C or above
Singapore: Singapore-Cambridge GCE O Level (English) at Grade C6 or above
South Africa: Senior Certificate (Matric) in English at 60% (Grade C) or above / Standard 10 Certificate (English)
Tanzania: Tanzanian Certificate of Secondary Education (TCSE) in English / Advanced Certificate of Secondary Education (ACSE) in English at Grade C or above
Zambia: Zambian Secondary School Certificate (ZSSC) / GCE in English at Grade 6/Credit or above
Zimbabwe: GCE O Level (English), Grade C or above
General: International Baccalaureate English Higher Level or Standard Level at 5
If you are applying for a Postgraduate course and your country is not listed above and if you have you taken one of the recognised English Language qualifications, please contact the Admissions Team.
If your High School English Language qualification was awarded more than 10 years ago you will also be asked to provide a standard English Language test, or take part in an English language interview.
If you have a WAEC certificate, please share your results with us via the WAEC website so we can verify them, or supply your scratch card details.
Previous Study in a majority English speaking country
You may not be required to submit evidence of your English language ability if you are from one of the following countries or territories, or you have completed a qualification equivalent to a UK degree in one of them.
The following criteria will apply:
Study in the UK or other accepted majority English-speaking country for at least 2 years of your undergraduate degree. Have completed and been awarded your degree no more than 3 years before the intended start of your chosen course.
Studied in the UK or other accepted majority English-speaking country for at least 1 year if you studied a postgraduate degree. Have completed and been awarded your degree no more than 3 years before the intended start of your chosen course.

Recognised English Language Qualification Scores
These lists show the scores we require for different English language tests and entry to our Pre-sessional English programmes.
Most of our postgraduate programmes will require one of these standard IELTS bands. You can check the English language scores required for your programme in the entry requirements on our course information pages.
For postgraduate programmes with a requirement of
IELTS overall 6.5 with 6.0 in each skill

English language test scores
English language test scores equivalent to IELTS 6.5 overall with a minimum score of 6.0 in each skill
IELTS: 6.5 overall, minimum of 6.0 in each skill
TOEFL iBT (Tests taken before 21st January 2026): 87 overall, minimum of 19 in reading, 19 in listening, 19 in speaking and 22 in writing
TOEFL iBT (Tests taken after 21st January 2026): 4.5 overall, minimum of 4 in each skill
Pearson PTE: 58 overall, minimum of 50 in each skill
LanguageCert Academic: 70 overall, minimum of 65 in each skill
Cambridge English: 176 overall, minimum of 169 in each skill
Kaplan Test of English: 478 overall, minimum of 444 in each skill
Oxford ELLT: 7 overall, minimum of 6 in each skill
Trinity ISE: ISE II with a minimum of Distinction in each skill
Oxford Test of English Advanced: 130 overall, minimum of 120 in each skill

The scores required are listed as IELTS but we will accept other approved English tests. Please contact us for the scores required for these tests.

10 week online Any accepted test 5.5 5.0

30 week in person UKVI test 4.5 4.0

Other English language requirements
We do have some postgraduate courses that require English language test scores different to those listed above. Please check the individual course pages.
You can contact us on the form below to request details of the scores required to meet these requirements with one of our approved English test.
Contact admissions
